Markets.title: Dollar holds near 19-month high as data supports case for US rate hikes
Markets.summary: The U.S. dollar is holding near a 19-month high due to positive economic data and Federal Reserve comments supporting interest rate hikes. Meanwhile, Japan reported record October exports driven by semiconductor demand, and cryptocurrencies saw minor gains.

Markets.title: Gold hits over one-year low ahead of Fed minutes
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped to their lowest level since October 2025 due to a strong U.S. dollar and expectations of further interest rate hikes. Investors are now awaiting the upcoming Federal Open Market Committee minutes for additional market direction.

Markets.title: Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a negative start; Asian shares trade higher
Markets.summary: GIFT Nifty futures indicate a negative opening for the Indian stock market today. Meanwhile, Asian shares are trading higher across the region.

Markets.title: Amazon, Google each to own over 14% of Anthropic stock after IPO
Markets.summary: Anthropic is preparing for an initial public offering to raise approximately $64.4 billion. Following the IPO, Amazon and Google are set to own roughly 15% and 14% of the company's stock, respectively.

Markets.title: Anthropic said to guide IPO price to top of range or above
Markets.summary: Anthropic is guiding its upcoming IPO price to the top of its $70 to $78 range or higher due to demand outpacing supply nearly sevenfold. The artificial intelligence company has the potential to raise about $90.4 billion in the offering alongside an additional $26 billion through private placements.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares rebound as Nvidia forecast eases AI trade concerns
Markets.summary: Asian shares rebounded after Nvidia's earnings report eased concerns about the artificial intelligence trade. Following the chipmaker's results, Nasdaq 100 contracts jumped 1.3% and S&P 500 contracts rose 0.7%.

Geo-Political.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine launched a planned missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in Russian-annexed Crimea. President Volodymyr Zelensky hailed the operation as an unprecedented success after the bridge partially collapsed.

Geo-Political.title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv launched a seven-stage attack that caused major damage to the Crimean Bridge. The bridge serves as a key symbol of Russia's occupation of Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday following the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang. The company stated that it will not reinstate Huang as its leader.

Geo-Political.title: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material
Geo-Political.summary: Philippine police have asked prosecutors to file child sexual abuse material charges against Thomas Markle, who is currently in U.S. custody. Markle has previously denied all allegations against him.

Geo-Political.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
Geo-Political.summary: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv with military strikes, terrifying local residents seeking shelter. Meanwhile, Ukraine has severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

Geo-Political.title: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian military plane crashed in the Kemerovo region, killing all 19 people on board. The Russian defence ministry preliminarily attributes the incident to a technical malfunction.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: A new open-source AI tool called REA allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The software eliminates the need to spend months learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to reverse engineer apps, features, and games.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities for the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body is also advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is holding pre-budget consultations with various stakeholders over the coming days. The meetings will include industry leaders, bankers, social sector experts, and for the first time, young people and retired bureaucrats.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027: Economists oppose LTCG tax cut as industry seeks abolition; what they told Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of Budget 2027-28, economists advised Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to retain the capital gains tax on equities. This advice directly opposes demands from industry leaders who are strongly seeking the complete abolition of the tax.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027-28: Govt to invite Gen Z for pre-Budget consultations; Sitharaman meets economists
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has started pre-Budget consultations with economists for the Union Budget 2027-28. The government also plans to gather input from Gen Z, industry leaders, trade unions, and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Centre hikes windfall tax on diesel, ATF exports; petrol levy unchanged — Check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has increased the windfall tax on exports of diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel. Meanwhile, the export levy on petrol remains unchanged following this latest revision.

India.title: Lashkar Terrorist Trapped In J&K, Cops Tell Him To Surrender On Video Call
India.summary: An accomplice of top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat was killed during an encounter in Kulgam on Monday. Police communicated with another trapped terrorist via video call and urged him to surrender.

India.title: Farmer Wins Rs 12 Crore Punjab Diwali Bumper Lottery After 15 Years Of Buying Tickets
India.summary: Baljinder Singh won the Rs 12 crore Punjab Diwali Bumper lottery after purchasing tickets regularly for nearly 15 years. He bought the winning Rs 500 ticket shortly before the Diwali festival.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi Flags India's 'Economic Crisis' In US, BJP Calls Him Anti-India
India.summary: During an interaction at Columbia University, Rahul Gandhi criticized India's Election Commission and alleged vote tampering. In response, the BJP condemned his remarks and labeled him anti-India.

India.title: No Increase In Punjab Voters, UP Leads With 18.84 Lakh Additions In Rolls
India.summary: Punjab's electorate remains unchanged at approximately 2.01 crore voters between the final SIR roll and the draft SSR list. Meanwhile, Uttar Pradesh led the country by adding 18.84 lakh voters to its electoral rolls.

India.title: Prince William, Princess Kate To Meet PM Modi In Delhi Today
India.summary: Prince William and Princess Kate are scheduled to meet Prime Minister Modi in Delhi today. This marks the royal couple's second official visit to India, following their previous trip in April 2016.

India.title: Encounter Breaks Out In J&K's Kulgam Between Security Forces, Terrorists
India.summary: Security forces and terrorists have engaged in an encounter in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district. This follows an earlier attack on a CRPF Naka in Akhran on November 11, which was carried out by Umar Nisar Dar and LeT Commander Lateef Bhat.

General.title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
General.summary: China worries an Nvidia spy scandal will increase pressure on the US to further restrict advanced chip sales. This unexpected hurdle arises as leaders Donald Trump and Xi Jinping meet.

General.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
General.summary: UK police arrested an American soldier on suspicion of espionage and national security violations. The suspect was subsequently transferred to US military custody.

General.title: Burnham to set out options next month for long-term EU relationship
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham will present long-term options for the UK's relationship with the European Union next month. He plans to release these options alongside his upcoming 10-year economic plan.

General.title: The EU that Burnham is eyeing up is very different to the one Britain left
General.summary: Andy Burnham is advocating for closer UK alignment with the European Union. However, the bloc has changed significantly since Britain originally left it.

General.title: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
General.summary: Former minister Alan Milburn has proposed shifting government spending away from welfare benefits and toward job support. The government supports this initiative to prevent a lost generation of unemployed workers.

General.title: William and Kate on Earthshot Prize green carpet in Mumbai
General.summary: William and Kate arrived in Mumbai to attend the Earthshot Prize ceremony. Five projects aimed at solving climate challenges were each awarded one-million-pound prizes at the event.
